# `scope_park`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Send the mount to its home (park) position, optionally selecting the equatorial or alt-azimuth home mode.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build: C / MUTATOR established independently, full contract parity unresolved) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, guider handler @0x7d700 (64-bit guider build); driver GoHome @0xf0050; 32-bit handler @0x79040 |

Requires a connected mount that supports homing. When equ_mode parses, the handler first asks the main imager whether a ViewPlan is running and fails with 536 if so; omitting or mistyping equ_mode skips that query. The driver then sends the home command, records the requested mode and starts the movement-watcher function. The reply is sent on acceptance; arrival is not awaited. The ScopeHome function event reports working and terminal states, and the watcher can change the equatorial mode after the move; ordering against the reply is not established. The handler returns result 0 when the driver's go-home call reports its success convention, otherwise it forwards the driver's error. Mount serial (firmware 9.31, READ): :hC, then a watcher polls :GU every 500 ms and sends :Q on exit.

Side effects: Sends the home command to the mount controller, records the requested mode, starts the movement-watcher worker; may switch the equatorial mode when the move ends.

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"scope_park"`. [READ] |
| `params` | any | no | - | Optional. An object {equ_mode} or a positional array [equ_mode]. A bare scalar is not bound and is treated as absent. [READ] |

| `Timestamp` | string | no | - | (both) Decimal string `<seconds>.<nanoseconds>` with exactly nine fractional digits, formatted with `%ld.%09ld` from clock_gettime clock id 1. Linux clock id 1 is CLOCK_MONOTONIC, so the value is monotonic time, not wall-clock or Unix time (INFERRED from the clock id). On replies it is added by the socket layer and is normally present; receivers MUST NOT require it on replies (absent on a stop_func relay-failure reply). ## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 210 | The mount or its driver does not support homing | `not supported` |
| 315 | No mount is connected | `mount is not connected` |
| 536 | equ_mode parsed and a ViewPlan is working | `view plan is already running` |
| 203 | The driver finds the movement watcher busy (reported by the driver's go-home path, not in the handler's explicit list) | `equipment is moving` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request is not an object, is an empty object, or has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: no method of type string (a non-string method counts as missing) | `invalid request` |
| 101 | Dispatcher: text fails to parse | `invalid JSON request: <reason> on line <n> ...` |
| 103 | Dispatcher: unregistered method | `method not found` |

Further branches forward an error code set by the mount driver or a helper; the codes are not exhausted by this table.

## Example

Request, bare - No parameters:

```json
{"id":51,"method":"scope_park"}
```

Request, equatorial - Select equatorial home mode:

```json
{"id":52,"method":"scope_park","params":{"equ_mode":true}}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"scope_park","result":0,"code":0,"id":51}
```

Reply, plan-running:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"scope_park","error":"view plan is already running","code":536,"id":53}
```
